messages.text:
"Create a 2D pixel art game in the Mystery, Adventure, and Psychological Horror genres. The story follows Noah, a young man who wakes up in an empty train station with no memories. He discovers an old radio receiving mysterious broadcasts from deceased individuals.
Gameplay focuses on exploration, simple puzzles, NPC interactions, and dialogue choices that influence the story.
Use retro pixel art, a mysterious atmosphere, ambient music, and a save system.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
